lines.text: The night after the third shard seats itself, she is there again, sharper, as if the dream has been swept clean.
She is pacing her cell. Not the pacing of a worried woman. She steps, counts, marks the wall with her thumbnail. Measuring it.
Clearer this time. Whatever you did, do it again.
She goes back to measuring before the dream lets go, as if he were one item on a list, and the list is long.
